messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | EGA | Corporate Affairs, ESG, Government Relations and Global Growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Buerk,

I am writing to share a strategic value proposition prepared specifically for Emirates Global Aluminium as EGA advances its global growth, decarbonisation, recycling and international industrial partnerships.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department, at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory within a capital-intensive multinational mining environment.

EGA's operating model is closely aligned with the areas where I have built my experience: complex government interfaces, mining and industrial operations, sustainability governance, community and social performance, renewable-energy stakeholder coordination, carbon-data traceability and cross-functional execution across technical and corporate teams.

Rather than send a conventional CV alone, I have attached an EGA-specific strategic value brief together with my three-page international executive CV. The brief identifies where I believe my experience could support EGA across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, International Growth, Social Performance or country-facing execution.

Given your leadership of Corporate Affairs, I would value your perspective on where this profile could add the strongest value within EGA or its international growth platform.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposition for Emirates Global Aluminium
strategic_brief.executive_summary: EGA is moving through a period of global growth, decarbonisation, recycling expansion, supply-chain resilience and increasing international stakeholder complexity. My value proposition is to strengthen the institutional and execution layer connecting those priorities. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead country-facing government and regulatory relations, ESG and social responsibility coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a capital-intensive mining environment. I would bring EGA direct operating experience across mining, industrial stakeholder relations, government coordination, sustainability evidence, community and social performance, renewable-energy governance and cross-functional execution relevant to EGA's UAE operations and international growth platform.
strategic_brief.company_context: EGA is the UAE's largest industrial company outside oil and gas and a global premium-aluminium producer with an increasingly international footprint. In 2026 EGA reported continued progress on global growth, including the Oklahoma primary aluminium project, recycling expansion in Europe and the United States, and ongoing decarbonisation through low-carbon products and major clean-energy agreements. EGA's official reporting also highlights government engagement, Aluminium Stewardship Initiative certification, responsible sourcing, supply-chain resilience and stakeholder partnerships as strategic priorities. These priorities create a strong need for leaders who can connect corporate affairs, government relations, ESG commitments and operating execution across complex jurisdictions.

opportunities.title: Government and Institutional Affairs Integration
opportunities.rationale: EGA's industrial operations and international growth depend on sustained relationships with governments, regulators, investment authorities, communities and strategic partners. Expansion into new jurisdictions increases the number of institutional interfaces affecting approvals, operating continuity, reputation and long-term licence to operate.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would map priority institutional relationships, decision pathways and engagement ownership, then establish executive briefs, relationship plans, commitment trackers and escalation protocols. My current mandate applies this discipline across mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, taxation, standards, trade and investment interfaces.

opportunities.title: ESG and Sustainability Execution
opportunities.rationale: EGA's decarbonisation strategy, low-carbon products, ASI certifications, green finance and responsible sourcing commitments require credible operating evidence and consistent governance across assets and jurisdictions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would link ESG commitments to accountable owners, physical operating data, stakeholder actions and executive reporting. I have coordinated a carbon-accounting proof of concept using physical operating records and support stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

opportunities.title: Mining and Upstream Stakeholder Strategy
opportunities.rationale: EGA's integrated value chain includes bauxite mining, alumina refining, smelting, recycling and global logistics. Upstream activities bring social, environmental, regulatory and community risks requiring disciplined engagement and evidence.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I bring direct gold-mining operating experience across government relations, community engagement, social performance, regulatory coordination, environmental interfaces and executive issue management, providing a transferable perspective for mining and upstream stakeholder work.

opportunities.title: International Growth and Country Readiness
opportunities.rationale: EGA's expansion into the United States and Europe increases the importance of country-level institutional intelligence, stakeholder mapping, community expectations, permitting awareness and coordinated external positioning before and after capital deployment.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support country-readiness frameworks combining government relations, ESG, stakeholder analysis, local-partner considerations, social-performance risks and implementation ownership for selected growth markets.

opportunities.title: Corporate Affairs and Executive Issues Management
opportunities.rationale: Industrial operations face reputation-sensitive issues across safety, environment, community impacts, labour, supply chains, permitting and government commitments. Leadership needs concise, fact-based coordination across corporate and technical teams.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish executive issue briefs, stakeholder-risk registers, evidence trackers and escalation protocols. I routinely coordinate sensitive regulator-facing matters across operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams.

days_0_30: Confirm priority UAE and international workstreams where corporate affairs, government relations or ESG execution would create the strongest value.
Map regulators, ministries, community interfaces, strategic partners and internal owners against active business priorities.
Review stakeholder commitments, external dependencies, sustainability evidence and executive escalation processes.
days_31_60: Select three to five priority pilots based on strategic exposure, stakeholder complexity and leadership sponsorship.
Build integrated stakeholder and country-readiness plans with clear objectives, ownership, evidence requirements and escalation thresholds.
Create an executive dashboard covering institutional dependencies, commitments, emerging issues and partnership opportunities.
days_61_90: Launch pilot engagement plans with concise executive briefing materials for priority government and institutional interactions.
Connect ESG and sustainability commitments to operating data, action owners and management review.
Establish a structured lessons process for repeatable practices across assets and markets.
days_91_180: Scale effective practices into a common toolkit for corporate affairs, government relations, ESG governance and country readiness.
Measure impact through issue closure, regulatory milestones, stakeholder outcomes, evidence quality and reduced execution friction.
Institutionalize reporting that gives leadership earlier visibility of external dependencies and reputation-sensitive matters.

potential_impact: Earlier identification of government, regulatory, community and stakeholder dependencies around major industrial and growth initiatives.
Stronger integration between corporate affairs, sustainability commitments and operating execution.
Improved country readiness for international expansion and portfolio growth.
Higher-quality executive decisions through concise stakeholder intelligence and issue escalation.
A repeatable framework connecting EGA's global growth strategy with institutional trust and long-term operating legitimacy.
